To know how long you spent in each app, Android requires a special permission. The data stays on the phone. Without it there is no tracking and no blocking.
The block screen appears on top of the app that crossed its limit. Without this, the pet rots quietly but nothing gets blocked.

Permission for exact scheduling so the pet wakes up fresh at exactly 00:00. Without it the reset still happens, just a few minutes later.

The change applies in %1$d seconds. You can change your mind.
To block apps, Rikavon has to stay awake in the background. Some manufacturers kill such services without asking. Two steps fix it.
Lets the service run in Doze. Actual cost: a short poll every few seconds only while the screen is on.
Security › Permissions › Autostart: enable for Rikavon. Also: Battery › App battery saver › No restrictions.
Settings › Device care › Battery › Background usage limits: remove Rikavon from "Sleeping apps" and add it to "Never sleeping apps".
Phone Manager › App launch: turn off automatic management for Rikavon and keep all three options on.
Settings › Battery › App battery optimisation: Rikavon › Don\'t optimise. Also enable Auto-start.
i Manager › App manager › Autostart: enable for Rikavon. Battery › High background power consumption: allow.
Settings › Battery › Battery optimisation: Rikavon › Don\'t optimise. On older devices also "Auto-launch".
On Pixel and most other brands the exemption above is enough. If the service still stops, look for "Autostart" or "Background apps" in settings.
Zero network. Zero analytics. Zero third-party SDKs. Everything stays on the phone.

The list of installed apps, their usage time and open counts for today and up to the last 90 days, the limits and schedules you set, the daily score, streaks and achievements. All of it to show you the pet and the statistics.
Nowhere. The app has no internet permission at all. No server, no account, no device identifier.

Usage access: to measure minutes and opens. Display over other apps: to show the block screen. Query all packages: so you can choose what to limit. Notifications: the service\'s silent notification and an optional evening summary.
In a local database inside the app. History older than 90 days is deleted automatically. A backup is only created when you export a file yourself.
Uninstalling the app deletes all data. There is no copy anywhere else.
